name: Ketamine
tierNotes: Threshold: near-clean — the faintest softness only.

Light: still very close to clean; only acuity/desat/coolCast are perceptibly non-zero, and only just. The shared breathing/drift/flowWarp trio (the same surfaces-bow-along-their-own-contours mechanics most other substances use for baseline life) are on the 'late' curve, so they're barely present yet — enough that the render is never a dead static filter, not enough to read as distortion. No black surround at all — the frame is fully rectangular.

Common: breathing/drift/flowWarp are now clearly perceptible — walls and surfaces visibly bow/crawl along their own contours, gently — but stay well short of their ceiling (late curve keeps them at ~1/8 max here), which is the fix for feedback that Common had become 'too strong': it used to run these on the smooth curve (~half strength already at Common) stacked with a second, redundant bespoke drift mechanic doing the same job — removed the bespoke one and moved everything to late so Common reads as mild. Vertical doubling and painting-flattening begin in earnest partway through; world recession hasn't woken up yet. (Perf/lag fix: this profile briefly also carried the shared patternMask/symmetry params, which forced the shared P3 pattern pass to run its full expensive kaleidoscope/domain-warp computation on every frame from around Light onward — a substantial constant GPU cost for a texture effect ketamine's own kCubism/kDissolve already provide. Removed; P3 goes back to early-exiting for this substance. Stutter (frame-hold) was also on the smooth curve, freezing ~28% of frames even at Common, which read as literal lag — now on the late curve too, so it's rare until Strong/Heavy.)

Strong: world visibly shrinking inside a soft, breathing circular boundary; environmental cubism/scenery-slicing (PsychonautWiki's own documented ketamine geometry — 'algorithmic... synthetic... simplistic in complexity', milder and less intricate than a psychedelic fractal) is now strongly readable — 11 facets (was 6) and harder posterize banding read as genuine fragmentation/abstraction rather than a few large tinted regions; hard-edge protection on mortar lines/object outlines is largely gone; breathing/drift/flowWarp are well past halfway to their ceiling now (late curve), so the whole frame is visibly alive, not just the facets.

Heavy: full k-hole — recession and its breathing boundary are near maximum; cubism is pushed to its ceiling across 11 facets with starker posterize contrast; above ~0.68 the receded painting's own structure visibly crawls/breathes along its contours via a real 2D domain-warp, and above ~0.78 its colour gives way hard to a continuous, texture/luminance-masked pattern advected along those contours, with a thin graphic band-edge contour line (an ink-like darkening, not a highlight) so the result reads as a structured, hand-drawn pattern rather than a soft blur. breathing/drift/flowWarp are at full strength here too (late curve reserves their ceiling for Heavy specifically, per feedback that Heavy should read as 'more psychedelic-like' than before) — flat, posterized, desaturated-cool, tinted from the photo's own dominant palette. Takes inspiration from the psychedelics' structure-driven pattern language while staying in ketamine's own documented 'algorithmic'/low-complexity register, never LSD/DMT's rainbow or fractal tiling.
